narrative.overview: A student wall in July 2024: painted green, lettered by hand in chalk and crimson, real photos taped up as paper sheets. The site reads as that wall, not a corporate template. Mood: urgent, communal, proud, hand-made. Bangla and English sit side by side and both get brush treatment.
keyCharacteristics: One flat green ground everywhere; sections never change green.
Chalk-white brush headlines (Atma), dim-chalk body (Anek Bangla).
Crimson is paint: nav, CTA band, wave lines, underlines, numerals.
Content on tilted paper sheets with tape, never on cards.
Red wave dividers whose crimson line draws itself left to right.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: All section grounds are exactly #0f3b2e. No texture, no gradient, no lighter band.

rules.name: The Red Moves Rule
rules.body: In wave animations only the crimson line moves; the green fill stays static.

rules.name: The No Drips Rule
rules.body: Brush lettering is clean. No blood-drip or splatter effects on headlines.

rules.name: The Tape Rule
rules.body: Anything lifted off the wall is a taped paper sheet. No floating cards.

dos: Do put photos on paper sheets, no captions.
Do animate only the red line in waves; reduced-motion shows all static.
Do use literal on-brand text colour (#fffaf2) on brand-filled buttons, since tokens remap dark.
donts: Don't add gradients, textures, glass or rounded cards.
Don't animate the green in waves.
Don't make the whole footer crimson; only its selection.
Don't restyle admin, dashboard or BloodHero zones with this world (out of scope).
